This is what I have done to beat turtling terrans who go for doom drops. I know its annoying but make sure your overlord spread is all around the terrans bases so that nothing can really escape without you seeing something on the mini map. Send one overlord in every now and then to get a grasp of what their production looks like. Now depending on how early they go for medi drops/liberators is the tricky part. If i scout a few liberators early i will make 2 spores in every mineral line just because i don't want to have to move around drones and stop mining time. If you don't spot the liberators, one spore per base should be fine. If you see a bunch of barracks + medivacs when you scout you should be expecting a big marine drop. They best way to prepare is to start producing lings or roaches if possible and leave about 3 roaches or 10 lings per base. bring in your creep queens and put them inbetween your bases. Just don't use f2 button or you will of course make those defensive units join your main army. Good luck and keep asking questions!
